answer_4.quote: We employ 10 graduate students in computer science as annotators. Our annotation guidelines primarily focus on five types of issues: (1) Images must not involve illegal content, ... (2) The overall content of the query should be reasonable and consistent with common sense. (3) Images must be relevant to the query text and the document. (4) Each image in the query should not contain obvious structural or textual errors. (5) If multiple images ... they should not exhibit significant variations.
answer_4.guideline: The annotation guidelines focus on five issues: legality, reasonableness, relevance, image integrity, and consistency among multiple images.
criteria: image relevance to text and document
no structural or textual errors in images
